summary: FX Inline still has strong page-layer currency-conversion technology but almost no commercial system. The shortest path to first revenue is one fixed-fee B2B pilot for local-currency price hints on a USD-only public pricing page, not a consumer paywall or more technical polish.
key_context_inputs_used: docs/revenue-reviews/context/ is missing, so there is no user-provided business ground truth for traffic, installs, costs, or monetization constraints.
docs/SAAS_ROADMAP.md still keeps account, subscription, billing, and a backend-managed rate service out of scope.
apps/website/index.html still includes a note saying the store links should be updated once published, which damages trust.
apps/website/main.js still contains no analytics, lead capture, or funnel logic.
Public versioning is still inconsistent across repo and marketplace surfaces.
context_gaps_or_conflicts: No monetization preference between consumer, affiliate, or B2B
No explicit willingness to do outbound sales
Marketplace version surfaces do not line up cleanly with the repo version
ignored_paths_or_categories: graphify, Graphify, and generated graph artifacts
previous narrative revenue reports as analytical ground truth
previous generated daily JSON report artifacts as analytical ground truth
test files as primary analytical inputs
generated build output and packaged artifacts as primary analytical inputs

results: extension unit and content tests passed

recommended_focus.title: Sell one fixed-fee B2B pilot for client-side local-currency hints on a USD-only SaaS pricing page
recommended_focus.why: This uses the repo's strongest current asset immediately, avoids waiting for consumer scale, and does not require subscription infrastructure before there is a buyer.
recommended_focus.smallest_viable_test: Rewrite the website around one pilot offer, create personalized before-and-after demos on real prospect pages, and try to close one paid pilot via outbound.

ranked_monetization_opportunities.title: Fixed-fee pilot for local-currency price hints on existing public pricing pages
ranked_monetization_opportunities.rationale: The extension already proves the hard page-layer behavior. One paid pilot creates revenue, proof, and buyer learning faster than waiting for installs.
ranked_monetization_opportunities.smallest_test: Personalized outreach to USD-only pricing pages plus a pilot landing page.

ranked_monetization_opportunities.title: Parser and runtime packaging plus implementation services or licensing
ranked_monetization_opportunities.rationale: The parser core is credible, but the package is still private and there is no buyer proof yet.
ranked_monetization_opportunities.smallest_test: After pilot demand appears, package the smallest reusable parser and DOM runtime pieces with support.

ranked_monetization_opportunities.title: Use-case content paired with affiliate offers
ranked_monetization_opportunities.rationale: Wise, Travelpayouts, and shopping assistants prove the economics, but FX Inline lacks traffic.
ranked_monetization_opportunities.smallest_test: Publish one high-intent use-case page and one affiliate experiment only after basic measurement exists.

ranked_monetization_opportunities.title: Paid consumer extension tier
ranked_monetization_opportunities.rationale: Users in this category strongly prefer free, private, simple tools. FX Inline has no trust cushion yet.
ranked_monetization_opportunities.smallest_test: Do not test until installs, activation, and ratings improve.

top_actions.title: Choose one wedge and one fixed-fee pilot offer
sequential_dependencies: The wedge decision must happen before the website rewrite and outbound copy.

top_actions.title: Rewrite the website into a pilot-sales surface
sequential_dependencies: CTA and analytics should be live before outreach starts.
success_metrics: one landing page that supports outreach without apology

top_actions.title: Build personalized proof assets and a 30-prospect list
sequential_dependencies: Personalized demos should target real prospects, not generic pages.

top_actions.title: Run outbound and close one paid pilot
sequential_dependencies: Implementation work should only start after real prospect engagement.

assumptions: The founder can use AI-assisted coding and AI-assisted design tools to move quickly.
A one-off fixed-fee pilot can be sold before building subscription infrastructure.
Target prospects will care more about international price comprehension than about having a full localization suite.
B2B outbound is acceptable unless later context files say otherwise.
risks: No one may care enough to pay for page-layer currency hints.
Prospects may actually want full localization or checkout changes, which FX Inline does not currently provide.
Performance or accuracy issues on a live prospect page could kill trust quickly.
Zero-review public trust and inconsistent versioning may hurt reply rates.
